welcomeTitle: A little care for the everyday.
welcomeText: A beautiful place for the things your household needs. Shared lists, thoughtfully kept in sync.
signInText: Sign in with your household’s identity provider. Your shopping encryption keys stay separate from your account.
serverUnavailable: The server is unavailable. Try again when your connection returns.
ssoDisabled: Account sign-in is not configured on this server yet.
listSubtitle: A small list. One less thing on your mind.
emptyText: Add the first thing you need. Everyone in your household will see it after syncing.
quietText: Your list belongs to your household. Changes are encrypted here before they reach the server.
privateNote: Only approved devices hold your list keys.
browserTrust: Your browser trusts this site’s delivered code. Use the Android app when you need stronger protection from the server operator.
connectText: Your account is ready. Connect this browser to an encrypted household to use its shared lists.
vaultText: Choose a strong passphrase for this browser’s encrypted storage. It is never sent to the server.
unlockText: Enter this browser’s passphrase to open your household keys and saved list.
passphraseHelp: Use at least 14 characters. Keep it somewhere safe. If you forget it, an owner must invite this browser again.
name: Name
joinText: Paste the full invitation from a household owner. It must belong to this server.
joinHelp: Ask the owner to verify the full fingerprint shown next before approving this device. Signing in alone never grants list access.
firstHouseholdText: To share the list already on your phone, create its household in Android and invite this browser. The original local list stays on your phone.
firstHouseholdStart: In Android, open Settings > Shared lists > Create a household. Server address:
firstHouseholdCode: Ask your server administrator for a one-time household setup code. Enter it in Android, then save and verify your recovery kit.
firstHouseholdShare: Choose Share a local list to create an encrypted shared copy. Your original local list stays on your phone.
firstHouseholdInvite: Choose Invite someone and paste the invitation below. In Android, open Review requests and compare this browser's full fingerprint before approving.
fingerprintText: Show this complete fingerprint to your household owner through a trusted channel. They must compare every character before approving.
waitingApproval: Your request is waiting for the household owner.
joined: This browser is approved. Your encrypted list is ready.
householdHelp: The household owner can invite and approve devices. Account administrators cannot grant access to encrypted lists.
noHousehold: This browser has not joined a household yet.
accountSubtitle: Your sign-in, your sessions, your choice.
sessionHelp: Revoking a browser session immediately stops its linked devices from reaching the server. Household keys and encrypted local work remain on that browser.
accountEncryption: Your account and household encryption are separate. Account access does not recover lost encryption keys.
adminHelp: Disabling an account revokes its sign-in sessions. These controls cannot read shopping contents or change household membership.
confirmDisableText: All of this account’s browser sessions will stop immediately. Its household membership and encrypted local data stay in place.
confirmRevokeText: The affected browsers will need to sign in again before their linked devices can sync.
changesSaved: Your change is saved in this browser.
conflictNotice: Some edits need review in the Android app. Your pending work has been kept.
unsupported_browser: This browser needs native WebCrypto, Ed25519, X25519, IndexedDB and Web Locks support. Try a current browser.
weak_passphrase: Use a passphrase between 14 and 1,024 characters.
vault_in_use: Your private space is already open in another tab. Lock it there first.
storage_unavailable: Private storage could not be saved. Your space has been locked to protect pending work.
wrong_passphrase: The passphrase could not open this browser’s private storage.
wrong_origin: This invitation belongs to another server. Open that server’s web app.
invite_expired: This invitation has expired. Ask the owner for a new one.
already_joined: This browser already has a household or a pending invitation.
forbidden: Access is no longer available. Sign in again or ask your household owner to check this device.
unauthenticated: Your sign-in has expired. Sign in again to sync.
recovery_required: This household is frozen after a server restore. Your pending work is preserved. Use the Android recovery process.
upgrade_required: This list needs a newer client. Your saved work has been kept.
history_unverifiable: The server could not prove that this list continues your saved history. Sync has stopped and your work has been kept.
unverified: The encrypted response could not be verified. Sync has stopped.
unverified_join: This invitation’s approval could not be verified. No household keys were accepted.
unverified_snapshot: This list snapshot could not be verified. Sync has stopped.
rotation_required: This device’s encryption limit has been reached. Ask an owner to rotate household keys in Android.
edit_conflict: The item changed while you were editing. Reopen it to review the current version.
intent_conflict: A saved change conflicts with the server. Your work has been kept for review.
quota_exceeded: This household or browser has reached a storage limit. Your saved work has been kept.
too_large: This response exceeds the supported size. Your saved work has been kept.
rate_limited: The server is busy. Wait a moment and try again.
invalid: This action could not be completed safely. Your saved work has been kept.
not_found: This list or account is no longer available.
unavailable: The server is busy. Your saved work is waiting to sync.
membership_conflict: Household membership changed. Refresh before trying again.
epoch_stale: Household keys changed. Refresh before trying again.
conflict: The request conflicts with current server state.
accountRequired: Sign in before opening this browser’s encrypted storage.
invalidName: Enter an item name of at most 1,000 characters.
lockHelp: Your space locks when you leave this page or after five minutes without activity.
localSignInText: Use your server account password. Your browser vault has its own separate passphrase.
passwordHelp: Use 15 to 128 characters. Spaces are preserved. This does not change your browser vault passphrase.
activationText: Your server administrator provides this secret. Activation creates account access only. A household owner must still approve your browser.
passwordChanged: Account password changed. Sign in again. Your browser vault passphrase is unchanged.
createUserText: Create a local account and hand its one-use activation secret to that person through a trusted channel.
usernameHelp: 3 to 64 letters, digits, dots, underscores or hyphens. No email address. Usernames are lowercase.
resetPasswordText: Existing account sessions will be revoked. Give the new one-use secret to this person. Household keys and vault passphrases cannot be reset here.
activationSecretText: Copy this secret now and deliver it privately. It is shown only once and expires at {date}. Never put it in a link.
invalidPassword: Use an account password of 15 to 128 characters, without control characters.
invalidUsername: Enter a username of 3 to 64 ASCII letters, digits, dots, underscores or hyphens.
localLoginFailed: The username, password or one-use secret could not be verified. Try again.
quantity_unsupported: This quantity is outside this browser’s supported range: zero, or 0.000001 to 1,000,000,000,000. Review it in Android. Sync has stopped and your work is preserved.
legacy_ids_unsupported: This list contains legacy item identifiers this browser cannot replay safely. Use Android to review or copy it to a fresh list. Sync has stopped and your pending work is preserved.
number_unsupported: This browser cannot safely read a number format used by this list. Review it in Android. Sync has stopped and your pending work is preserved.
appearanceHint: Choose your palette. Light and dark follow your device.
palette_grove_description: Botanical greens and soft oat tones.
palette_tide_description: Ink blue, sea glass and cool paper.
tutorialWelcomeBody: A short tour of your shared shopping space. Your account, your household and this browser each have a separate setup step.
tutorialWelcomeHint: You can skip now and reopen Guided tour from the navigation at any time.
tutorialHouseholdBody: Start a new household here after signing in, or bring your existing Android list from Settings > Shared lists. Either way, save and verify your recovery kit when creating the household.
tutorialHouseholdHint: Web creation needs no setup code. Android creation uses a one-time server code. Android also works on its own, offline.
tutorialVaultTitle: Give this browser its own keys.
tutorialVaultBody: Sign in with SSO or a local account. Set a separate browser passphrase to encrypt its saved keys. Your account password does not unlock this storage.
tutorialVaultHint: Create a household here or paste an invitation. When joining, compare the full fingerprint with the owner before approval.
tutorialListBody: Once approved, add, check and edit items here. Changes are encrypted in this browser and sync with your household. Offline changes wait here until you reconnect.
tutorialListHint: Your space locks when you leave this page or after five minutes without activity. Owners can invite and approve devices here. Recovery and advanced owner actions are available in Android.
createHouseholdText: Create your first shared list here. Save a recovery kit, then invite Android devices or other browsers. No setup code is needed when you are signed in.
recoverySaveHelp: Before creating anything on the server, download the encrypted recovery file and save its key separately. Keep both somewhere safe so you can recover ownership in Android if you lose this browser.
recoveryKeyHelp: This is separate from your browser passphrase. The server cannot recover it for you.
recoveryReadBack: Select the file you just saved
recoverySaved: I have safely saved the file and its key separately.
creationPendingHelp: The connection was interrupted. Continue with the same saved keys and list. Your recovery kit is still valid.
ownerInviteHelp: Send this invitation privately to the person or device joining. It expires after 10 minutes. Then approve their full device fingerprint here. An invitation alone does not grant access.
ownerApproveHelp: Compare the entire fingerprint with the one shown on the joining device, in person or over a trusted channel. Enter that device’s fingerprint below. Approval shares this household’s lists.
ownerFingerprintInput: Fingerprint shown on the joining device
ownerNoRequests: No devices are waiting for approval.
ownerRemoveHelp: Remove this device from the household? List keys will rotate so it cannot read future changes. Data it already received cannot be erased remotely.
ownerHelp: You own this household. Invite and approve devices here. Your saved recovery kit can restore ownership in Android. Account administrators cannot read lists or grant membership.
pending_changes: Sync your pending list changes before changing household membership.
ownerDiscardHelp: Verify the server state and discard this change only if it can no longer be committed? Changes with an uncertain outcome will be retained. Shopping edits and verified history will be kept.
creationAbandonHelp: The server confirmed that its household quota prevented creation. Cancel this setup to join an existing household instead? Keep your saved recovery kit until you finish setting up.
recoveryReadBackError: The saved file or key does not match this recovery kit. Select the saved file and enter its key again.
ownerFingerprintMismatch: Could not verify this device. Check its full fingerprint and try a fresh invitation if needed.
pairIntro: Connect your Android phone without typing server details. This invitation is private and can be used once.
pairStepScan: In Android, open Settings > Shared lists > Scan invitation QR.
pairStepConnect: Scan this code, check the server address and tap Connect this phone.
pairStepVerify: Choose Scan phone verification below, then point your computer’s camera at the QR on your phone.
pairCameraPrivacy: Camera frames are processed on this device and are never uploaded.
pairExpired: This invitation expired. Create a new code.
pairManual: Use a link or manual verification
pairCopyHelp: Select and copy the invitation manually.
pairManualHelp: Paste the link in Android instead of scanning. To approve without a computer camera, close this dialog, open Review join requests and paste the complete fingerprint from the phone through a trusted channel.
pairCameraUnavailable: The camera is unavailable or permission was denied. Allow camera access and try again, or use manual verification.
pairWrongQr: This QR does not match a request for this invitation. Scan the verification QR shown on the phone you are connecting.
pairApproved: Phone approved. It will connect automatically.
importModelMemory: This connection and its key stay only in memory until this dialog closes or the app locks. Requests go directly from your browser to the provider.
importNoModelOrigins: Your server has no image-model endpoints enabled. Ask its operator to allow a provider origin. Markdown import remains available.
importMarkdownHelp: Paste Markdown or open a UTF-8 file. List entries and recipe ingredients are read locally. Checked entries, code blocks and instructions are skipped.
importPhotoHelp: Connect a model that can read images, then choose a JPEG or PNG, or use your camera. A synthetic image checks support first. Only the prepared photo is sent when you choose Read photo.
importEmpty: No usable entries were found. Try another source.
importReviewHelp: Check each name and quantity. Model results can be wrong. Existing items are skipped, and your list changes only when you confirm.
importFailed: Could not import this source. Your saved list is kept.
importModelEndpoint: Enter a valid model API base URL from the allowed origins, and a model name. Use HTTPS, except for localhost.
importModelBudget: This connection has reached its model-call limit. Connect again with a suitable limit if you want to continue.
importModelMissing: Connect an image model first. No photo was sent.
importModelImages: The model did not pass the image check. Choose an image-capable model. No photo was sent.
importModelAuth: The provider rejected this connection. Check your API key.
importModelConnection: Could not reach the model. Check its URL, connection and browser CORS access.
importModelOutput: The model returned no usable structured reply. Try again or use Markdown.
importImageInvalid: Choose a readable JPEG or PNG photo.
importTooLarge: This source is too large. Use at most 30,000 Markdown characters, 150 entries or a photo of at most 10 MB.
importMarkdownInvalid: Choose a UTF-8 Markdown or plain text file.
importCameraFailed: Could not use the camera. Check permission or choose a photo file.
